transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I'm here because I just can't seem to stay focused on anything. The main thing is I get pulled off track by every little sound or thought. Like, I’ll be trying to work on a job application, and then a car drives by outside, or my phone lights up, or just some random idea pops into my head. And before I even notice it, I'm doing something completely different and the application is just sitting there. It's really frustrating.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety when you're trying to sit still?

Yeah, definitely. Whenever I'm sitting with someone, my leg is usually bouncing. Or I'll find myself clicking a pen or just messing with my keys. Most of the time, I don't even realize I'm doing it until I catch myself. But yeah, just sitting completely still is pretty tough for me.
Have you always had trouble staying focused and sitting still, even as a child?

Yeah, pretty much. I mean, even back in elementary school, it was always a problem. My teachers were constantly moving my seat because I talked out of turn a lot. And I was always forgetting my homework, too. When we had worksheets, I'd just rush right through them and end up making all these careless mistakes. So, yeah, it's definitely been going on since I was a kid.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?
I'm not really sure about that one. I mean, I don't think I do things without thinking, at least not any more than anyone else does. I guess I haven't really noticed that being a big issue for me.
Can you think of any times when you've done something without thinking it through first?

I'm trying to think, but... no, I really can't come up with anything. Like I said just a minute ago, I don't feel like I just jump into things blindly. I mean, maybe I've done it once or twice like anyone else, but no specific examples are coming to mind right now. I just haven't really noticed it being a thing for me.
Have your difficulties with focus and restlessness caused problems for you at work, school, or in your relationships?

Yeah, it definitely has. Especially when it comes to work and trying to get a career going. I've been trying to become an automotive technician, and I know I can do the hands-on part of the job just fine. But I keep missing these training deadlines, or I'll mess up the applications and have to redo them. It's just... I can't seem to get organized enough to actually move forward with it. So yeah, it's definitely causing some problems.
Have your difficulties with focus and restlessness caused problems for you in your personal relationships?

Um, not really, no. I mean, I haven't noticed it causing any major issues with my friends or family. We get along fine. It's really just the work and career stuff that's taking the hit, like I was saying. But in my personal life... no, nothing really comes to mind.
Are your difficulties with focus and restlessness causing problems for you in other areas of your life beyond work?

No, not really. Like I said, it's mainly just the work and training stuff that's a struggle right now. I don't really have any hobbies or anything else going on where it's getting in the way. So, no, it's just the career stuff.
You mentioned it's mainly affecting your work and training, but are there any other areas of your life where you feel like your difficulties with focus and restlessness are causing problems?

Um, no, honestly I can't think of anything. I know we kind of just went over it, but yeah... it really is just the job stuff. Day-to-day, I do alright. It's just when I have to actually sit down and handle the applications or the deadlines for the auto tech training that everything falls apart. So, no, nothing else really comes to mind.
Do you experience restlessness or fidgeting in quiet environments, like when you're at home watching TV or reading a book?

Yeah, actually. Quiet stuff is pretty hard for me. Like, if my family is trying to watch a movie or if I try to just sit down and read a book... I can't really just sit there. I end up starting to talk, or I'm getting up and walking around, or just making noise. I don't mean to bother anyone, it's just really hard to stay still and quiet for that long.
Do you often interrupt others when they're speaking?

Yeah, I do that a lot. I cut people off all the time, especially my mom or my counselor. It's like... an answer just pops into my head while they're talking, and I just say it before they're even finished. I don't really mean to be rude, it just kind of comes out.
Do you often blur out answers before questions have been completed?

Yeah, that's pretty much what I just meant. If my mom or my counselor is asking me a question, I'll usually just spit out the answer before they even finish getting the words out. It's exactly like I was just saying with the interrupting.
Have you experienced these focus and restlessness issues consistently over the past few months?

Yeah, it's been pretty consistent. I'd say it's been this disruptive for about... maybe a year and 10 months now. It all really started getting this bad after I had a soccer injury. That kind of knocked me out of my usual routine, and things have just been like this ever since.
Do you experience restlessness or fidgeting in most situations, not just at work or school?

I'm not really sure about that. I mean, I don't have a job or go to school right now anyway, so I can't really compare it to that. But... I haven't really noticed if I'm restless everywhere else. I don't think it happens in most situations, or at least I haven't really caught myself doing it.
Would you describe your symptoms of inattention, hyperactivity, and impulsivity as causing significant distress or impairment in your daily life?

Yeah, I'd say it definitely holds me back. Like... I'm trying to become an automotive technician. I know for a fact I can handle the hands-on work, that part is fine. But I've missed training deadlines, and I've had to redo my applications so many times that I'm just... I'm still not moving forward with it. It's really frustrating because I know I can do the actual job, but these issues just keep getting in the way of me actually getting there.
Did you experience significant symptoms of inattention, hyperactivity, or impulsivity before the age of 12?

Yeah, it goes back that far. Even when I was in elementary school, my teachers were always having to move my seat. I was always talking out of turn, forgetting to bring my homework in, and just... rushing through all my worksheets and making a bunch of careless mistakes. So, yeah, it's been an issue since I was a kid.
Have you experienced difficulties with focus, restlessness, or interrupting others in multiple settings, such as at home, with friends, or in other activities outside of work or training?

I'm honestly not sure. Like I said before, I haven't really noticed it happening everywhere. When I'm just at home or hanging out with friends, things are pretty relaxed, so... I don't think I'm interrupting them or losing focus like I do when I'm trying to get my career stuff sorted out. If it does happen in those other situations, I guess I just haven't really caught it.
Do you experience difficulties with focus, restlessness, or interrupting others when you're with friends or in other activities outside of work or training?

Like I was just saying, I don't really think so. When I'm with my friends or just hanging out, I don't notice those kinds of problems. Things are pretty chill, so if I am being restless or interrupting, it's not something that stands out to me. It really only seems to be an issue when I'm trying to deal with my career stuff.
Have you experienced difficulties with focus, restlessness, or interrupting others in at least two different settings, such as at home, with friends, or in other activities?

I know you're asking about different places again, but... honestly, my answer is still the same. It's really just the one area—when I'm dealing with my career and trying to get work stuff done. When I'm at home or hanging out with my friends, I just don't have those problems. So, no, I wouldn't say it happens in two different settings.
Did you have any problems with paying attention, sitting still, or interrupting others when you were a little kid, before you were a teenager?

Yeah, actually. Even back in elementary school, I had a lot of trouble with that kind of stuff. My teachers were always having to move my seat because I'd talk out of turn all the time. And I was constantly forgetting my homework, or if we had worksheets to do in class, I'd just rush through them and make a bunch of careless mistakes. So, yeah, it was definitely an issue when I was a kid, too.
